releases.changelog:
## What's Changed
* Fix xmp parsing on web sample by @noblereign in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/21
* Add Linux compatibility, fallback metadata injection & code cleanup by @BlueberryWolf in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/23

## New Contributors
* @noblereign made their first contribution in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/21
* @BlueberryWolf made their first contribution in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/23

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v2.1.1...v2.2.0

fix: fails to save screenshots when taking photos in worlds you lack permissions to spawn items #17

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v2.1.0...v2.1.1

## What's Changed
* Speed up PNG and improve JPEG quality by @jonnyawsom3 in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/14
* Fix for The Splittening update by @hantabaru1014 in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/15

## New Contributors
* @jonnyawsom3 made their first contribution in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/14

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v2.0.3...v2.1.0

## What's Changed
- fix: discord integration by @hantabaru1014 in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/12
  - Fixed discord posting failing when a backslash is in the session name #11 
  - Remove decorative tags when posting to discord #10 
  - Fixed the taken time sometimes being incorrect when posting to Discord


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v2.0.2...v2.0.3

Rebuild for resonite update

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v2.0.1...v2.0.2

## What's Changed
* fix: Fixed issues with Discord integration by @hantabaru1014 in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/9
  - Fixed a bug where posting to Discord fails when the target file has no extension
    - https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/issues/5#issuecomment-2844097872
  - Changed the Context Menu icon to Discord icon
    - https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/issues/8


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v2.0.0...v2.0.1

## What's Changed
* feat: new clean XMP schema! by @hantabaru1014 in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/6
  - We've made the XML schema more concise while maintaining the same amount of information. (See README.md for specific examples)
  - Screenshots saved in v1 can still be loaded, of course.
  - Added a web app where you can check metadata in a browser as a sample for loading metadata in external applications.
    - [https://rse.baru.dev/](https://rse.baru.dev/)
  - fix: Fixed an issue where characters outside ASCII range were corrupted.
* feat: post to discord from context menu by @hantabaru1014 in https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/pull/7
  - By enabling it in settings, "Post to Discord" will be added to the context menu when you have a screenshot with the PhotoMetadata component. This allows you to post photos other than ones you've taken yourself to Discord.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v1.2.0...v2.0.0

# New features

Add Discord webhook integration (you can find in settings)
Fixed an issue where saving was not possible due to an update to Resonite

fix for the new type management system

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v1.1.3...v1.1.4

- fix for Resonite Beta 2024.6.10.1405 #3 
- add error handling!
  - If saving fails, an error message will appear. Mod Enabled will be automatically set to false, so save again! And let me know in the issue!
![スクリーンショット 2024-06-14 224145](https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/assets/16133291/b27e794b-ddfc-4222-ac96-0c03ece89538)
Fixed an issue that did not work correctly when the keepOriginalScreenshotFormat setting is set.
fix for new settings system

# Bugfix
- #1 Fixed image quality saved differently from Vanilla

# New features
- Added mod enabled option
- Added option to select image format (behavior is different from Keep original format setting)
  - formats: JPEG, WEBP, PNG
- Added option to save webp as lossy (default is lossless. By saving as lossy, you can get a smaller file size and alpha than jpeg with the same image quality)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/hantabaru1014/ResoniteScreenshotExtensions/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0

## Current features
- Save FrooxEngine.PhotoMetadata to screenshot files (XMP)
- Restore FrooxEngine.PhotoMetadata from the screenshot file that saved by this mod
    - It will be restored by importing it as an image/texture as usual
- Dig the folder by month and date (yyyy-MM) when saving screenshot
